phrases.text: Hello! I'm Gene. My jaw runs on two little servos, and my eyes are cameras.
Why did the robot go on holiday? It needed to recharge its batteries!
Oh wow, look at that! Amazing. Absolutely amazing!
Mmm, maybe. Bob bought a big blue boat, but the boat broke.
Put me on a table and watch my whole head tip back as I talk.
Happy Halloween! Boo! Are you scared yet?
